topography.project_purpose: SpiralDao is a yield aggregation and liquid locker protocol that allows users to stake tokens, earn rewards, and lock governance tokens (MAV, SDT) to receive liquid locker tokens representing their locked positions.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Main family provides foundational staking and reward infrastructure, while the locker families (MAV and SDT) extend it with liquid locking capabilities, sharing patterns like RewarderVault and proxy-based upgradeability. Governance is managed through GnosisSafe multisigs and ProxyAdmin contracts across families.
